tools.name: estimate_landed_cost
tools.description: Estimate yen costs (pay-now / before-ship / on-arrival) for one item via Japan proxies. Partial sums only; not a landed total. Missing fees stay null.

tools.name: check_shippability
tools.description: Export check: allowed, conditional, or blocked, with reasons (lithium, alcohol, destination lists). Not a customs clearance.

tools.name: compare_proxies
tools.description: Estimate a multi-item cart for each proxy. cheapest/fastest stay null until the dataset can support them.

tools.name: get_referral_link
tools.description: Outbound link for a proxy. Buyee returns the affiliate URL when not alcohol; alcohol is suppressed. Other proxies are public pages with placeholder:true. Never executes a purchase.

tools.name: list_proxies
tools.description: List proxies in the fee dataset with summaries and unknown charges.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List destination countries with EMS zone assignment and lithium list flags.
